title: Understanding Precision
text: Precision is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total number of positive predictions (true positives + false positives).

title: Effect of Increasing Threshold
text: Increasing the threshold generally means that fewer instances are classified as positive. This can affect precision, recall, and accuracy.

title: Precision and Threshold Relationship
text: When the threshold is increased, the number of false positives usually decreases, which can lead to an increase in precision.

title: Precision Calculation
text: If the number of true positives is $$80$$ and false positives is $$20$$, what is the precision?

title: Recall and Threshold Relationship
text: Increasing the threshold can decrease recall because fewer true positives are identified.

title: Accuracy and Threshold Relationship
text: Accuracy can either increase or decrease depending on how the true positives, false positives, true negatives, and false negatives change.
